name: test-once
description: Run an expensive repository-wide test suite once per exact source and environment fingerprint, then reuse the passing result across Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Share full-suite test results across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Test Once combines lifecycle hooks with a concurrency-safe local cache. Configured full-suite commands are redirected through a single-flight runner, while targeted tests continue to run normally.
defaultPrompt: Configure Test Once for this repository's full test suite.
Run or reuse the configured full test suite safely.
